title: Reverse component trace inclusion
statement: Let g : P → T be a locally finite type, quasi-compact morphism of schemes. Let g(x) = y, let V be open with y ∈ V, and let A ⊆ P have clopen trace on g⁻¹(V ∩ closure {y}). Assume x ∈ A. Assume also that g⁻¹({y}) ∩ A is preconnected. Then g⁻¹({y}) ∩ A lies in the connected component of x in g⁻¹({y}).

proof.text: Apply IsPreconnected.subset_connectedComponentIn to the fibre trace, using g(x) = y and x ∈ A for membership and Set.inter_subset_left for containment.

proof_origin.note: Topological proof in Mathlib of the corrected trace statement; no geometric sorry used.

lean.statement:
theorem generic_fibre_component_spread_trace_reverse {P T : Scheme.{u}} (g : P ⟶ T)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g] (y : T) (x : P) (hx : g x = y)
    (V : Set T) (A : Set P)
    (hV : IsOpen V) (hy : y ∈ V)
    (hcl : IsClopen {q : g ⁻¹' (V ∩ closure {y}) | (q : P) ∈ A})
    (hxA : x ∈ A) (hconn : IsPreconnected (g ⁻¹' {y} ∩ A)) :
    g ⁻¹' {y} ∩ A ⊆ connectedComponentIn (g ⁻¹' {y}) x
